Steak with chimichurri 🥩🌿
Steak: 1 ribeye, salt, pepper. Sear 4 minutes per side and rest 5 minutes.
Chimichurri: 1 cup parsley, 3 cloves garlic, ½ cup olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar. Chop the parsley and garlic, then stir in the oil and vinegar.
